title.zh: Hugging Face用旧版Qwen3训练DNA模型：14B跑分逼近GPT-6.1
title.en: Hugging Face用旧版Qwen3训练DNA模型：14B跑分逼近GPT-6.1

current_state.zh: Hugging Face and academic partners open-sourced Carbon-X, a Qwen3-14B-based DNA model that scores 66.7% across five genomic benchmarks—nearly matching GPT-6.1 Sol's 67.5% at roughly 1/1800 the inference cost—with open weights and local quantized versions for sensitive genetic data.
